title.en: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Sagnay, Province of Camarines Sur
title.orig: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Sagnay, Province of Camarines Sur

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2778_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The following sitios in the Municipality of Sagnay, Province of Camarines Sur, are constituted as distinct and independent barrios of said municipality, to wit:
1. The sitios of Aniog and Bolo, to be known as the barrio of Aniog; and
2. The sitios of Bognalon, Suboc, Oyagno, Amislag and Cagbalogo, to be known as the barrio of Bognalon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
